instruction.text: Setze das passende Modalverb in die Lücke ein.
instruction.sound: Setze das passende Mo-dal-verb in die Lücke ein.

atoms.a: Du könntest Blumen auf deinem Balkon pflanzen, um Schmetterlinge anzulocken.
atoms.b: You ((++could must may)) plant flowers on your balcony to attract butterflies.

atoms.a: Wir sollten nicht wandern gehen, ohne ausreichend Wasser mitzunehmen.
atoms.b: We ((++shouldn't mustn't can't)) go hiking without taking enough water with us.

atoms.a: Yasin darf das Ladekabel seines besten Freundes benutzen.
atoms.b: Yasin ((++may should can)) use his best friend's phone charger.

atoms.a: Saskia darf nicht vergessen, ihren Spind zu verschließen.
atoms.b: Saskia ((++mustn't couldn't shouldn't)) forget to close her locker.

atoms.a: Tiana should use sunscreen when she spends the day at the beach.
atoms.b: Tiana ((++is_supposed_to is_able_to has_to is_allowed_to)) use sunscreen when she spends the day at the beach.

atoms.a: If you listen closely, you can hear the birds singing in the trees.
atoms.b: If you listen closely, you ((are_supposed_to ++are_able_to have_to are_allowed_to)) hear the birds sing in the trees.

atoms.a: Silas may take part in the dance performance because he has practised a lot.
atoms.b: Silas ((is_supposed_to is_able_to has_to ++is_allowed_to)) take part in the dance performance because he has practised a lot.

atoms.a: The broken pieces must be removed quickly so that our cat does not hurt itself.
atoms.b: The broken pieces ((are_supposed_to are_able_to ++have_to are_allowed_to)) be removed quickly so that our cat does not hurt itself.

instruction.text: Wandle den Satz in die gegebene Zeitform um.

atoms.a:
He can hear the thunder in the distance.

simple past
atoms.b: He ((will_be_able_to was_supposed_to ++was_able_to)) hear the thunder in the distance.

atoms.a:
Sora must hurry up to catch her train.

will future
atoms.b: Sora ((++will_have_to will_be_able_to had_to)) hurry up to catch her train.

atoms.a:
My sister's friends may play my new video game.

will future
atoms.b: My sister's friends ((++will_be_allowed_to were_able_to were__allowed_to)) play my new video game.

atoms.a:
Kian should finish reading the last chapters by Friday.

simple past
atoms.b: Kian ((was_able_to ++was_supposed_to will_be_able_to)) finish reading the last chapters by Friday.
